info.name: Gets the periods of unavailability for persons in the given account

params.name: accountId
params.description: The Account ID

params.name: start
params.description: Date from which to start the range (Default: 0001-01-01)

params.name: end
params.description: Date from which to end the range (Default: 9999-12-31)

params.name: boundRange
params.description: Setting this value to true will truncate the dates returned to the specified start and end date paramters

params.name: type
params.description: Type of the unavailability date range (Default: Unavailability)

params.name: state
params.description: State of persons to filter results by (Default: Active)

params.name: personIds
params.description: Optional comma delimited list of person IDs to filter the results if set

items.docs:
By default this endpoint will return only Periods of Unavailability. NOTE: If you wish to retrieve Pre and Post employment dates you will need to pass the "type" param in the query. NOTE: If you do not have Private Read permissions, description will return as null for private periods of unavailability.
Permissions
Person: Read
HourlyProfile: Read
Unavailabilities: Read
HourlyUnavailabilities: Read
Private: Read

info.name: Gets the periods of unavailability for a person in the given account.

params.name: accountId
params.description: The Account ID

params.name: id
params.description: Id of the person to get unavailabilities for

params.name: start
params.description: Date from which to start the range (Default: 0001-01-01)

params.name: end
params.description: Date from which to end the range (Default: 9999-12-31)

params.name: offset
params.description: The number of items to skip before starting to collect the result set

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of results to return

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: The order to return unavailabilities. Default is StartDateAscending

items.docs:
NOTE: If you do not have Private Read permissions, description will return as null for private periods of unavailability.

info.name: Adds periods of unavailability to a person in the given account

params.name: accountId
params.description: The Account ID

params.name: id
params.description: Id of the person to get unavailabilities for

items.docs:
Periods of unavailability cannot overlap with employment dates and cannot overlap with existing periods of unavailability. NOTE: If you do not have Private Write permissions, you cannot create private periods of unavailability.
Permissions
Private: Write
Person: Read
HourlyProfile: Read
Unavailabilities: Write
HourlyUnavailabilities: Write

info.name: Updates periods of unavailability to a person in the given account

params.name: accountId
params.description: The Account ID

params.name: id
params.description: Id of the person to get unavailabilities for

items.docs:
This endpoint will only update the fields that are provided in the objects of the array. Any fields not included will use the existing values. NOTE: Periods of unavailability cannot overlap with employment dates and cannot overlap with existing periods of unavailability. NOTE: If you do not have Private Write permissions, you can update the start and end date of private periods of unavailability, but not the description or whether it's private.
